title: The Mindless door, the save and the reveal sit in the same room as the running timer, and the door says when the session would end

source.ref: Owner decision 2026-11-18 after LIVE-2393: bring the door, the reveal and the saving screens up to match the new timer (all three)

detail:
Found on the rendered timer after LIVE-2393: the running screen was rebuilt around the door's orb, but the screens either side of it were not. Finishing dropped the member onto a pulsing icon and one line of text while the log saved, a failed save was a line of text and a button, and the reveal was four cards on a plain page in the practice accent even after a walk. The door showed a length but not when that length would end.

DONE 2026-11-19: one shared room (components/on-air/stage-room.tsx: the orb's light behind a takeover, and the done-by time), kept apart from the running screen so the door does not pull it in. The save and the failed save are the same orb the member just sat with (StageNotice in live-stage.tsx): the ring turns while it saves (role status), the orb dims and Try again shows when it fails (role alert), in the mode's accent. The retry logic is unchanged. The reveal is lit by the orb of the timer that just ended, its numbers are in the display type, and its accents and rail follow the mode; the one-screen budget (reveal-fit.test.ts) is unchanged and measured with the partial banner at 390 by 700. The door is lit the same way on the sheet and the dialog, its orb sits in the empty ring the running screen fills, and it says Done by <time> in the member's own clock for any timed session (not for an open count-up or a log-only practice). No engine rule changed. Rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 for a sit and a walk.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
